name: LinkedIn acquisition for a commerce brand
goal: A useful evidence-backed LinkedIn campaign package, bounded by merchant contribution, cash and stock, with provider execution only when actually supported and authorized.
starts_from: An explicit LinkedIn commerce brief; this process is not a default addition to other channels.
metrics: Requested native artifacts and reproducible source-backed decisions
Kept-order contribution and cash/stock constraints, not unqualified platform leads

stages.name: Confirm merchant and channel fit
stages.say: Read brand/product/customer evidence and actual source definitions. Discover available LinkedIn account capabilities or use exports; do not invent channel data. A qualified-company to quote/order/contribution map and a commercial handoff to Mei.
needs: The user brief, current authority and dated source exports
stages.done_when: The channel hypothesis, source limitations, offer qualifications and real account scope are explicit.

stages.name: Make the campaign and measurement files
stages.say: Follow workflows/commerce-wholesale-acquisition.md. Deliver editable campaign, creative and measurement files within the approved channel share, contribution/cash/stock constraints. Reuse existing authority and expose unsupported operations. A qualified-company to quote/order/contribution map and a commercial handoff to Mei.
stages.done_when: The actual files are reviewable, arithmetic is traceable and every unsupported provider step is labeled.

stages.name: Apply only a supported authorized provider change
stages.say: Only if the requested LinkedIn operation has an available verified tool and valid account-scoped authority, execute the concrete diff and read it back. Otherwise finish the local package without claiming provider completion.
needs: Valid exact-account operation and budget authority
stages.publish: Only through a verified available LinkedIn interface within existing account-scoped authority; no connector is included or assumed.
stages.done_when: Returned object IDs and fresh readback support any claimed change; local-only work is explicitly distinguished.

stages.name: Return the business decision and next observation
stages.say: Recompute comparable metrics and preserve attribution and period differences. A qualified-company to quote/order/contribution map and a commercial handoff to Mei. Separate proposed tests, provider status, observed delivery and actual business outcomes.
stages.done_when: The owner receives a specific supported decision, usable artifacts and the exact remaining gap or next observation.

fit-review.passes_when: The intended customer and offer fit the merchant evidence; unsupported account facts are marked missing.

package-review.passes_when: The campaign stays inside channel allocation and business limits, and arithmetic, units and source qualifications are checked.

results-review.passes_when: Material calculations are reproducible and the report does not confuse platform claims with kept orders or realized contribution.
